daily_load_assessment: Current TSB is +3.39 (CTL 21.2, ATL 17.8), indicating low acute fatigue following 5 full rest days since October 7th. Although HRV is 39 ms, the extended rest period provides sufficient freshness to absorb a high-quality key workout today.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Over the past 21 days, volume has been very light with only 7 sessions (330 TSS total) and 1 quality effort. Fatigue (ATL) has decayed to 17.8. The acute system is fresh and under-stimulated, making this an ideal window to re-engage progressive overload.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: CTL is currently 21.2, significantly below the target CTL of 60. Long-term trends show high inconsistent spikes (TSS > 200 in June/July) followed by extended lulls. To reach CTL 60 safely, we must establish a consistent 70/30 pyramidal routine with a controlled weekly CTL ramp rate of +1 to +2.
coach_verdict: You are fresh and well-rested after 5 days off. Priority 1 is a VO2max Cycling Interval session to aggressively target your 5-minute peak power goal and jumpstart your CTL build towards 60.

priority_1.workout_details: 15 min Zone 2 warm-up with 3x30-sec high cadence spin-ups. Main Set: 5 x 4 minutes @ 285-300W (Zone 5 / VO2max) with 4 minutes Zone 1 easy spinning recovery. Cool-down: 15 min Zone 1/2. Total duration: ~65 mins.
priority_1.reason: Directly targets your primary goal of improving 5-minute cycling power. Your TSB is positive and acute fatigue is clear, allowing max quality in Zone 5.

priority_2.workout_details: 12 min easy Zone 2 jog + dynamic movement drills. Main Set: 5 x 1000m @ 5km race pace effort with 2 minutes light jog recovery. Cool-down: 10 min easy jog. Total duration: ~45 mins.
priority_2.reason: Secondary high-priority option addressing your 5km running performance goal. High quality interval work fits well within your current rested state.

priority_3.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 min bodyweight. 1) Barbell Back Squats: 4x6 @ 80kg. 2) Barbell Romanian Deadlifts: 3x8 @ 75kg. 3) Barbell Bench Press: 4x8 @ 65kg. 4) Overhead Press: 3x8 @ 40kg. 5) Sandbag Hug Carries & Plank Superset: 3 rounds.
priority_3.reason: If you prefer a non-impact strength day, this full-body session builds lower body power output for cycling torque and upper body aesthetics while preserving cardiovascular freshness.
